currentEmphasis.title: What the project is concentrating on right now
currentEmphasis.detail: The active frontier is expanding execution coverage — the breadth with which accepted decisions carry into concrete operational effect. Governance-backed provenance and receipts are the load-bearing parts of the system today; work is ongoing to connect more of the decisions the substrate records to the actions those decisions are supposed to authorize.

stages.label: Current emphasis
stages.title: Institution-in-a-box
stages.description: The core loop of cooperative life — identity, membership, proposals, decisions, and durable receipts — is the most mature part of the system. Governance-backed provenance and auditable coordination are load-bearing today. This is the part of ICN we are most willing to stand behind in public.

stages.label: Direction of work
stages.title: Execution coverage and shared rules
stages.description: Expanding the range of accepted decisions that translate cleanly into real operational effect, and the mechanisms that let shared rules bind practice rather than just describe it. This is the active frontier of the project. Real progress, real incompleteness — the direction is clear and the pace is real.

stages.label: Direction of work
stages.title: Federation and commons
stages.description: Inter-institutional coordination and shared resources across the network. Both are real, active subsystems with serious implementation behind them, and both are still maturing. In some places the implementation is ahead of the public-facing story, and the surfaces that would let outsiders see and evaluate this work are still being built.

stages.label: Direction of work
stages.title: Member-facing experience
stages.description: The surface through which ordinary members would interact with identity, governance, rules, accounting, receipts, and federation as one coherent environment. The capabilities underneath are real and in places strong. The interface on top is still catching up, and closing that gap is active work — not a finished capability.

stages.label: Long-term direction
stages.title: Public and civic-scale coordination
stages.description: Participatory budgeting, municipal governance, and public infrastructure coordination. The architecture is designed with this horizon in mind, but it is not where active work is concentrated today. When outsiders ask whether ICN does this, the honest answer is not yet — and we would rather say so than imply a schedule.
